turns.text:
{"sql": "SELECT i.route,
  SUM(l.qty*l.unit_price) AS revenue,
  SUM(l.qty*l.unit_cost) AS cogs,
  SUM(l.qty*(l.unit_price-l.unit_cost)) AS gross_margin,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoice_no) AS n_invoices
FROM erp_invoices i
JOIN erp_invoices_lines l ON l.parent_id = i.invoice_no
WHERE i.issued_on >= '2026-04-01' AND i.issued_on <= '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.route"}
